resources.string: Emulator save folders belong to other apps at arbitrary paths under /sdcard. Scoped storage and the media store cannot reach them, so this is the only way to read your saves.

Android 11 removed access to Android/data for normal apps. All-files access does not cover it and the folder picker cannot target it. Shizuku, activated over adb, is the only route on a device without root.\n\nThis is where every GameCube, Wii, PlayStation, legacy Citra and Vita save lives, along with Eden\'s profiles.dat.
